categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three main business segments: consumer electronics precision components and modules, new energy product components and connectors, and robotics and intelligent equipment. It focuses on manufacturing electronic connectors, precision small parts for smart electronics, precision structural parts and modules for consumer electronics, and components for new energy vehicles and energy storage. Additionally, it is developing intelligent humanoid robots and smart manufacturing equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including continuous mold production for stainless steel battery shells, stamping processes replacing laser engraving for cost efficiency, and innovative materials like Damascus steel and aluminum for metal appearance parts. It integrates AI technologies, multi-joint robotic arms, and embodied intelligence in robotics. The company also emphasizes new processes for battery components, such as high-energy density cell top covers and titanium shell development, alongside automation and intelligent production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major international consumer electronics brands such as Huawei and Apple, battery manufacturers, module integrators, and automobile OEMs in the new energy vehicle sector. The company serves end markets including smartphones, laptops, wearable devices, smart home products, electronic books, new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, and industrial robotics. It maintains long-term strategic partnerships with leading brands in both consumer electronics and new energy industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant production bases in China (Shenzhen, Sichuan, Jiangsu, Fujian), and overseas manufacturing facilities in Vietnam, Mexico, and Hungary (under construction). Its sales are nearly evenly split between domestic (China) and international markets, with about 50% revenue from each. The company also has subsidiaries and offices in the USA, Hong Kong, and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and sales of precision components and modules for electronic devices and new energy products. It supplies key parts to downstream manufacturers such as battery producers, module assemblers, and OEMs. It also engages in upstream R&D and innovation to enhance product capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company pursues a 'dual pillar + artificial intelligence' layout, strengthening consumer electronics and expanding new energy business, while cultivating AI-driven humanoid robotics and high-speed communication products. It emphasizes cost reduction, automation ('machine replacement'), global production base expansion, and technological innovation in materials, processes, and equipment. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on new manufacturing processes, advanced materials, and AI integration to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of precision components and modules to large international and domestic customers in consumer electronics and new energy sectors. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but on product sales, including customized and standard parts. It also derives income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading precision manufacturing and intelligent equipment provider in China, with strong market share in consumer electronics components and new energy vehicle parts. It competes by leveraging advanced technology, customization capabilities, and global production footprint to serve top-tier clients, maintaining a competitive edge in innovation and scale.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total revenue of approximately RMB 16.93 billion, a 23.4% increase over 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 771.5 million, an 800% increase year-over-year. The company’s assets totaled over RMB 20.17 billion, with net assets of nearly RMB 7.97 billion, reflecting strong growth and expansion. It maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, customized components with advanced manufacturing technologies that reduce costs and improve efficiency. It offers differentiated products with unique materials and innovative processes, such as AI-enabled robotics and high-performance battery components. Its global production network and strong R&D capabilities enable rapid market response and quality assurance, providing customers with reliable, cutting-edge solutions that support their product innovation and competitiveness.
